items.title: 엔씨 AI, 지스타 2026서 생성형 AI 플랫폼 '바르코' 체험 카페 운영
items.rationale: NC AI will run a hands-on VARCO cafe (3D model and sound generation) at G-Star 2026 and give 10 dev teams 3 months of free access. This is a concrete, time-bound offer that Korean developers can apply for.
items.excerpt: NC AI는 지스타 2026 기간(11월 19~21일) 부산 벡스코 인근에서 생성형 AI 플랫폼 '바르코' 체험 카페를 열고 3D 모델·사운드 생성 기술 체험과 1대1 상담을 제공하며, 10개 개발팀에 3개월 무료 이용을 지원한다.

items.title: Google gets Henry Cavill to AI vibe code a game to promote Googlebook, promises to donate $11 to charity every time someone plays it
items.rationale: A playable vibe-coded 16-bit game ('Mustache Protocol') with a video series that shows how it was built. Google is now selling AI game-making to the mainstream.
items.excerpt: Google has enlisted Henry Cavill to vibe-code a 16-bit side-scroller, 'Mustache Protocol', on a Googlebook, and is releasing a video series documenting the AI-assisted build; plays during November trigger Movember donations.

items.title: Hideo Kojima says AI lacks what makes the creative process fun, despite its efficiency
items.rationale: Kojima's first on-record view of AI in development (via Game*Spark): AI makes development easier, but it takes the fun out of making things. A high-signal creator perspective.
items.excerpt: In an interview with Game*Spark, Hideo Kojima said rapid AI advances have made game development far more manageable but that AI-driven creation is 'not a form of creation I find particularly interesting', voicing anxiety about AI's future role in creative work.

items.title: Kimi Launches Game Development Solution With K3.1 Agents Working Inside Unity, Unreal and Blender
items.rationale: A concrete new tool: Moonshot's Kimi Code/Work agents edit Unity, Unreal and Blender projects directly, and Moonshot demoed a 20-hour unattended run from concept to working prototype. It is the first major-lab agent suite aimed squarely at engine workflows.
items.excerpt: Moonshot AI's Kimi released a game-development solution pairing K3.1 models with Kimi Code and Kimi Work agents that edit Unity, Unreal Engine and Blender projects directly, demonstrating a 20-hour unattended run that turns a concept into a functional prototype.

items.title: テンセント、ゲーム開発に強い新AI『Hy4』発表　Unityなどでマルチプレイの実装を支援
items.rationale: Tencent's Hy4 was trained with input from its games division to write multiplayer game logic and track game state in Unreal, Unity and Godot, with reported gains on GameDev/GameLogic benchmarks. It is a new model tuned for the hardest part of engine scripting.
items.excerpt: Tencent's new Hy4 LLM was trained with input from its games division to implement multiplayer game logic and track game state, tuned for Unreal Engine, Unity and Godot; Tencent reports +19.1% on GameDev and +9.8% on GameLogic benchmarks vs the preview, and showcased a 3D driving sim built with it.

dedup.note: Shipping 5. RE-CURATION SWAP: removed Game Developer 'Valve warns of slower Steam approvals'. The enrichment fetch found no substantive AI content: Valve only cites a rise in submissions, and the AI link is the writer's speculation. The other Valve-review candidates (GamesRadar 'Valve cracks down', 4Gamer Steam review, cluster c0) were excluded for the same reason. Replacement: Real Sound Tech 'Tencent Hy4', a new model release tuned for Unity/Unreal/Godot multiplayer game logic, with GameDev/GameLogic benchmarks. The orchestrator's cross-section grep found no ledger or archive hit. Its history_match, Ramen Aura Autopilot 11-02, is a different company and product (an autonomous tester, not a code model). It is distinct from today's Kimi K3.1 pick: different lab, product and outlet. Other alternatives considered and passed over: Herald Roblox Kartrider clone (AI use is only speculated; part of the copycat thread), Astrocade/Nitro contests (marketing contests), NVIDIA Hogwarts DLSS 5 (already announced 10-14). Earlier drops stand: RuntimeWire Tripo Agentic Canvas (published in design on 11-05), GamesRadar Kojima (cluster c4 dup), Kotaku op-eds (stale), GI.biz opinion, Xsolla M&A, Take-Two Zelnick, FSR 4 GDK, Toyo Keizai, Anchornode, Nikkei Miyamoto.
